chunks: To God belong the secrets of the heavens and the earth, and all things will go back to Him. So worship Him and put your trust in Him; your Lord is not heedless of what you do.

key_terms.غَيْبُ: The unseen, secrets, or hidden matters known only to God

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge of the unseen and human actions?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah over both the visible and hidden realms, linking the metaphysical concept of *ghayb* to practical devotion. It serves as a bridge between divine omniscience and human accountability, reminding believers that their worship and reliance (*tawakkul*) are observed by a Lord who is never absent from their deeds. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on the unity of divine knowledge and action, where spiritual trust is grounded in the certainty of divine awareness.
